factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated and Separate Statements of Comprehensive Income: Gross profit for GROUP 2026: 12,907; 2025: 9,793 (increase of ~31.8%). Cost of sales for GROUP 2026: 16,916; 2025: 15,533 (increase of ~8.9%).

factual_claims.claim: Operating expenses increased 10.5% to EUR 3.316 million, while operating profit grew 34.5% to EUR 9.608 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated and Separate Statements of Comprehensive Income: Distribution costs and administrative expenses for GROUP 2026: 3,316; 2025: 3,002 (increase of ~10.5%). Operating profit for GROUP 2026: 9,608; 2025: 7,141 (increase of ~34.5%).

factual_claims.claim: Net finance costs improved substantially to EUR 0.784 million from EUR 1.777 million a year earlier.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated and Separate Statements of Comprehensive Income: Finance cost - net for GROUP 2026: (784); 2025: (1,777). The absolute value decreased, indicating improvement.

factual_claims.claim: Finance income increased to EUR 1.076 million, including a EUR 458 thousand net gain on derivatives, while finance costs declined to EUR 1.860 million from EUR 2.345 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Notes to Financial Statements (16): Finance income for GROUP 2026: 1,076 (includes net gain on derivatives of 458). Finance costs for GROUP 2026: 1,860; 2025: 2,345.

factual_claims.claim: Consequently, profit before tax increased 64.5% to EUR 8.824 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated and Separate Statements of Comprehensive Income: Profit before income tax for GROUP 2026: 8,824; 2025: 5,364. Percentage increase calculated as (8,824 - 5,364)/5,364 ≈ 64.5%.

factual_claims.claim: After income tax expense of EUR 1.577 million, consolidated net profit rose 63.8% to EUR 7.247 million, compared with EUR 4.426 million in the first quarter of 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated and Separate Statements of Comprehensive Income: Profit for the period for GROUP 2026: 7,247; 2025: 4,426 (increase of ~63.8%). Income tax expense for GROUP 2026: 1,577.

factual_claims.claim: Earnings per share increased from EUR 0.01 to EUR 0.02.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Notes to Financial Statements (17): Basic and diluted earnings per share for GROUP 2026: 0.02; 2025: 0.01.

factual_claims.claim: Total comprehensive income was EUR 7.274 million, including EUR 27 thousand of foreign-currency translation gains.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated and Separate Statements of Comprehensive Income: Total comprehensive income for GROUP 2026: 7,274. Other comprehensive income (foreign currency translation reserve): 27.

factual_claims.claim: The LNG terminal segment was the main contributor to the improvement.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Notes to Financial Statements (4) show LNGT segment profit increased from 1,328 to 4,529 (significant growth), outpacing other segments. This substantial improvement supports it being the main contributor.

factual_claims.claim: LNG terminal revenue increased to EUR 18.687 million from EUR 14.989 million, and segment net profit rose to EUR 4.529 million from EUR 1.328 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Notes to Financial Statements (4): LNGT revenue for GROUP 2026: 18,687; 2025: 14,989. LNGT segment net profit for GROUP 2026: 4,529; 2025: 1,328.

factual_claims.claim: Commercial LNG revenue increased to EUR 3.357 million from EUR 2.473 million, with segment net profit reaching EUR 1.128 million versus EUR 0.766 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Notes to Financial Statements (4): comLNG revenue for GROUP 2026: 3,357; 2025: 2,473. comLNG segment net profit for GROUP 2026: 1,128; 2025: 766.

factual_claims.claim: Liquid energy terminals revenue was broadly stable at EUR 7.779 million compared with EUR 7.864 million, but segment net profit declined to EUR 1.590 million from EUR 2.332 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Notes to Financial Statements (4): LET revenue for GROUP 2026: 7,779; 2025: 7,864. LET segment net profit for GROUP 2026: 1,590; 2025: 2,332.

factual_claims.claim: Group EBITDA increased 18.8% to EUR 16.153 million, although liquid energy terminals EBITDA fell to EUR 3.002 million from EUR 3.724 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Notes to Financial Statements (4): Group EBITDA for GROUP 2026: 16,153; 2025: 13,591 (increase of ~18.8%). LET EBITDA for GROUP 2026: 3,002; 2025: 3,724.

factual_claims.claim: Operating cash flow more than doubled to EUR 27.917 million from EUR 13.758 million, supported principally by a EUR 7.010 million decrease in receivables, compared with an increase of EUR 2.184 million in 2025.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated and Separate Statements of Cash Flow: Net cash flows from operating activities for GROUP 2026: 27,917; 2025: 13,758. Change in trade receivables (decrease) for GROUP 2026: 7,010; 2025: increase of 2,184.

factual_claims.claim: Investing cash outflow increased to EUR 10.771 million, including EUR 4.906 million of capital expenditure, while financing outflow rose to EUR 11.521 million due mainly to higher debt repayments and interest paid.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated and Separate Statements of Cash Flow: Net cash flows from investing activities for GROUP 2026: (10,771). Acquisition of property, plant, and equipment for GROUP 2026: (4,906). Net cash flows from financing activities for GROUP 2026: (11,521). Details include repayment of borrowings and interest paid.

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents increased to EUR 17.986 million from EUR 12.361 million at year-end, while total borrowings declined to EUR 302.069 million from EUR 311.194 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated and Separate Statements of Cash Flow & Balance Sheet: Cash and cash equivalents for GROUP 2026: 17,986; 2025: 12,361. Borrowings (current + non-current) for GROUP 2026: 20,340 + 281,729 = 302,069; 2025: 28,469 + 282,725 = 311,194.

factual_claims.claim: Total assets were EUR 556.798 million and equity increased to EUR 179.866 million from EUR 172.592 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated and Separate Statements of Financial Position: Total assets for GROUP 2026: 556,798; Equity for GROUP 2026: 179,866; 2025: 172,592.
